parameters.question: Compare chi-square test results for chromosome-level CpG-site uniformity, requiring the chi-square statistic to agree within 1% relative absolute error, degrees of freedom to match exactly, and treating a reported p-value of 0 as equivalent to a value below floating-point precision; ignore column order and extra columns.

Compare the reported chi-square statistic, degrees of freedom, and p-value for the Zebra Finch chromosome-distribution analysis. Require the chi-square statistic to agree within 1% relative absolute error and degrees of freedom to match exactly; accept a reported p-value of 0 when the true value is below floating-point precision. Ignore column order and permit extra columns.
